verdict.rationale: The evidence only gestures at autonomous or repeatable automation. It cites agents that 'keep work moving 24/7', Custom Agents manageable via API, Skills as pages describing a repeatable workflow, and event-driven webhooks. None of these items documents an actual scheduler, cron-style trigger or recurring job. missing for 10: explicit scheduled/recurring trigger documentation, configuration details for time-based runs, API control of schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
